BuildSynergy — Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Do you use WordPress?
A: No. We do not use WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, or any other website builder. Everything we build is hand-coded. For content-heavy sites that need a CMS, we typically use Sanity or Contentful integrated with a Next.js frontend.

Q: Can I update the website myself after it's done?
A: Yes, if your project includes a CMS. For marketing sites we almost always integrate a headless CMS so you can update text, images, and blog posts without touching code. For SaaS MVPs, content management depends on what was agreed in the brief.

Q: Do you offer hosting?
A: We handle deployment and recommend hosting providers, but we do not manage hosting on your behalf as an ongoing service. We typically deploy to Vercel (frontend), Railway or Render (backend), and Supabase (database). You will have your own accounts and own the infrastructure.

Q: What technology stack do you use?
A: For frontend: Next.js or SvelteKit, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS. For backend: Node.js with Fastify or Python with FastAPI. For databases: PostgreSQL via Supabase or Neon. We choose the stack that fits the project — we do not force a fixed stack on every client.

Q: How do I get started?
A: Fill in our contact form on the website and select "Start a project." We will reply within one business day to schedule a scoping call. If the project is a good fit, we send you a proposal within 48 hours of the scoping call.

Q: Do you sign NDAs?
A: Yes. We are happy to sign a mutual NDA before a scoping call if you are sharing sensitive product information. Send us your NDA template and we will review it.

Q: Can you work with my existing codebase?
A: It depends. We do an initial code review (free, one hour) to assess the quality and architecture. If the codebase is reasonable to work with, we proceed. If it needs significant rework before we can build on it, we will tell you upfront and quote for the cleanup separately.

Q: Do you do ongoing maintenance after the project is done?
A: We offer 30 days of free bug fixes after handover. Beyond that, we do not currently offer monthly retainers. If you need updates after the 30-day window, we handle them as separate small engagements.

Q: I have a tight deadline. Can you rush the project?
A: Sometimes. Rush projects are subject to a 20% premium and depend on our current availability. We will always tell you honestly if we can meet a timeline rather than overpromise.

Q: I only have a rough idea — is that enough to get started?
A: The Discovery stage exists exactly for that. You do not need a finished spec to have a scoping call. Come with your problem, your users, and a rough sense of budget and timeline — we will help you shape the brief.

Q: Do you offer equity deals instead of payment?
A: No. We do not take equity in exchange for work. We charge for our time and expertise.

Q: What happens if I'm not happy with the final product?
A: The design approval stage exists to prevent this. If the final build matches the approved design and brief, we consider the project delivered. If something does not match the spec, that is a bug and we fix it within the 30-day window at no charge. Subjective changes after handover — "I want the colour to be slightly warmer" — are change requests.

Q: Do you work with clients outside South Africa?
A: Yes. We have worked with clients in the UK, Germany, and the US. We invoice in ZAR but can discuss USD invoicing for international clients. Time zone overlap is important to us — we work best with clients no more than 4 hours behind or ahead of SAST.

BuildSynergy — Privacy Policy
Last updated: 1 March 2025

This policy explains how BuildSynergy (Pty) Ltd ("we", "us") collects, uses, and protects personal information when you use our website or contact us about a project.

--- What We Collect ---

--- What We Collect ---

Contact information: name, email address, phone number, company name — provided when you submit a contact form or email us directly.
Project information: details about your business, project goals, and budget shared during scoping calls or in written briefs.
Usage data: standard web analytics including page views, device type, and approximate location. We use Plausible Analytics, which is privacy-first and does not use cookies or collect personally identifiable data.

We do not collect payment card details directly. Payments are processed through PayFast, which has its own privacy policy.

--- How We Use Your Information ---

To respond to project enquiries and send proposals.
To communicate during an active project engagement.
To send occasional updates about BuildSynergy if you have opted in (you can unsubscribe at any time).

We do not sell your data. We do not share your data with third parties except service providers directly involved in running our business (email hosting, cloud storage, invoicing software). Each of these providers is bound by data processing agreements.

--- Data Storage ---

--- Data Storage ---

Project information is stored in Notion and Google Workspace. Both are encrypted at rest. Access is limited to the BuildSynergy team.
Contact form submissions are stored in our email system.
We retain project data for 5 years after project completion for legal and tax purposes. After 5 years, data is deleted unless there is an ongoing legal obligation to retain it.

--- Your Rights ---

--- Your Rights ---

You have the right to request access to the personal data we hold about you.
You have the right to request correction or deletion of your data.
You have the right to withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time.
To exercise any of these rights, email us at yoursupport@buildsynergy.co.za. We will respond within 14 business days.

We comply with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) as applicable in South Africa. For EU/UK users, we also comply with GDPR obligations to the extent required.

--- Cookies ---

Our website does not use tracking cookies. We use Plausible Analytics, which is cookieless and GDPR-compliant by default.

--- Changes to This Policy ---

--- Changes to This Policy ---

We may update this policy. If we make significant changes, we will note the updated date at the top of this document. Continued use of our services after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

--- Contact ---

Questions about this policy: yoursupport@buildsynergy.co.za
General enquiries: hello@buildsynergy.co.za
BuildSynergy (Pty) Ltd, Cape Town, South Africa

BuildSynergy — How We Work

--- Our Process ---

Every project follows the same four-stage process regardless of size.

Stage 1: Discovery (1 week)
We start with a scoping call — usually 60 minutes. We ask about your business, your goals, your users, and your timeline. After the call, we send a written brief back to you summarising what we heard. You review it and confirm. This brief becomes the contract for the project.

Stage 2: Design (1–2 weeks)
We work in Figma. You get a full desktop and mobile design before any code is written. We do two rounds of design revisions. A third revision round can be added for R2,500. Design approval is required before we move to build.

Stage 3: Build (2–10 weeks depending on scope)
We build in sprints of one week. At the end of each sprint you get a preview link. You can give feedback in writing via a shared document we set up for each project. We do not take feedback over WhatsApp or phone calls during the build phase.

Stage 4: Handover (1 week)
We deploy the project, run you through the codebase or CMS (depending on your tech), hand over all credentials, and do a final walkthrough call. After handover, we offer 30 days of bug fixes at no charge. Bugs are defined as something not working as specified in the brief. New feature requests after handover are scoped and quoted separately.

--- Communication ---

--- Communication ---

We work Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm SAST.
Our primary communication channel is email and a shared Notion workspace.
We do weekly check-in calls during active build phases — typically 30 minutes on Fridays.
We do not work on weekends. We do not take urgent calls outside business hours.

--- Timeline Expectations ---

--- Timeline Expectations ---

We are a small team. We typically run two to three projects at a time. If our calendar is full, we will let you know estimated availability. We do not promise start dates we cannot keep.

Rush projects (shorter timelines than standard) can sometimes be accommodated for an additional 20% rush fee. This is not always possible and depends on our current workload.

--- Revisions and Scope ---

--- Revisions and Scope ---

Two rounds of revisions are included in every project.
Changes that fall outside the agreed brief are scoped as change requests. We provide a written quote for any change request before proceeding.
We do not start change request work until it is approved and invoiced.

--- Payments ---

--- Payments ---

We invoice through a South African invoicing system. We accept EFT bank transfer and credit card via PayFast.
We do not accept PayPal, crypto, or deferred payment plans.
Late payments (beyond 7 days of invoice date) attract a 5% penalty per week.

BuildSynergy — Services

BuildSynergy is a small web development and design studio based in Cape Town, South Africa. We build custom websites, SaaS MVPs, and brand identities for startups and growing small businesses.

--- What We Build ---

Custom Websites
We design and build marketing sites, portfolio sites, and landing pages from scratch. We do not use WordPress or page builders. Every project is hand-coded using modern frameworks. Typical turnaround: 3–6 weeks.

SaaS MVPs
We take early-stage product ideas and build a working, deployable MVP. This includes frontend, backend, database, authentication, and deployment. We work closely with founders who have validated their idea but need to get something in users' hands. Typical turnaround: 8–14 weeks depending on scope.

Brand Identity
Logo, colour palette, typography system, and a basic brand guide. Often bundled with a website project. Can be done standalone. Typical turnaround: 2–3 weeks.

E-commerce
We build Shopify storefronts with custom themes and integrations. We do not build custom e-commerce from scratch unless it is part of a larger SaaS engagement.

--- Pricing ---

We charge project-based, not hourly.

Custom Website: R18,000 – R45,000 depending on scope and content volume
SaaS MVP: R65,000 – R140,000 depending on feature set
Brand Identity: R8,500 – R16,000
E-commerce (Shopify): R12,000 – R28,000

All prices are in South African Rand and exclude VAT. A 50% deposit is required before work begins. The remaining 50% is due on delivery.

--- What We Do Not Do ---

We do not offer ongoing maintenance retainers at this time.
We do not do print design, social media management, or SEO campaigns.
We do not build mobile apps (native iOS or Android).
We do not work with clients who have no budget defined — every engagement starts with a scoping call.

--- Clients We Work Best With ---

--- Clients We Work Best With ---

Startups at the seed or pre-seed stage who need a first digital presence or an MVP.
Small businesses that have outgrown a DIY website and want something professional.
Founders who know what they want but need someone to build it properly.

We are not the right fit for large enterprises, government contracts, or clients who need a team of 10 or more developers.
